'''2001 Vegas DPC warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Awesome Hobbies, Las Vegas, Nevada on 27 April 2001. [[Brandon Gravo]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2233">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-vegas-done-right-aka-jesus-in-sin-cityd2233/ vegas-done-right-aka-jesus-in-sin-city], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-vegas-done-right-aka-jesus-in-sin-cityd2233/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Vegas DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 27 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Awesome Hobbies, Las Vegas, Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brandon Gravo]]
